body.title: pathChanges source method
body.summary: Add required pathChanges(from, to, path) to ReviewSources; implement it in RegistryReviewSources through git_path_history { cwd: this.deps.repoPath, rev: from..to, path, fullHistory: true } with full-OID validation and field 'source' errors; wrap it in boundedProjectionSources (cached per [from,to,path], one budget.read per uncached call); bind it in every ReviewSources test literal. pathContinuity is not changed yet.
acceptanceChecks: A failed listing, a non-hexadecimal sha, or a sha whose length differs from the from/to OIDs raises TaskReviewInputError with field source.
Every existing task-review test that builds a ReviewSources literal still passes with pathChanges bound.

tests.name: pathChanges lists the commits that changed the path and refuses a failed or malformed listing as a source error
boundedProjectionSources caches pathChanges and charges one read per uncached listing
